items.title: Generate a Koala-managed Codex adapter manifest
items.context: Add .Codex/koala.json through koala init with fields that describe adapter ownership, recommended entrypoint, activity source, and excluded Claude runtime assets.

happy.desc: koala init writes .Codex/koala.json with adapterOwner=koala and activitySource=codex

edge.desc: adapter manifest records recommended entrypoints for both local wrapper and global KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE fallback

adversarial.desc: manifest explicitly excludes .Codex/hooks and .Codex/settings.json instead of generating unsupported runtime files

verificationEvidence.note: Fresh koala init verification requires .Codex/koala.json and asserts adapterOwner=koala plus activitySource=codex on current HEAD.
Generated manifest keeps node bin/koala-codex.js first and includes KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 koala fallback on current HEAD.
Manifest excludes .Codex/hooks and .Codex/settings.json; filesystem check confirms unsupported runtime files are absent on current HEAD.

items.title: Harden the Codex wrapper and entrypoint verification
items.context: bin/koala-codex.js should remain the stable executable entry that tags source=codex/session, and tests should verify both wrapper behavior and the generated adapter manifest.
items.userSees: Running node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief still prints # koala session brief and writes activity with source=codex/session tagging behavior covered by verification.

happy.desc: bin/koala-codex.js remains a working Codex-specific entrypoint for session_brief

edge.desc: wrapper derives a stable activity session from Codex/OpenAI/terminal environment variables when available

adversarial.desc: verification fails if wrapper stops tagging activity source as codex

verificationEvidence.note: entrypoints verification runs node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief and sees # koala session brief on current HEAD.
entrypoints verification checks wrapper session propagation and core/global fallback session_brief heartbeat with KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 on current HEAD.
entrypoints verification overrides wrapper source to not-codex and asserts wrapper still records source=codex on current HEAD.

items.title: Document that Codex gets an adapter, not hooks/settings
items.context: Update .Codex/README template and root docs to explain the adapter manifest and why .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json are intentionally absent.
items.userSees: .Codex/README.md says Codex uses a Koala-managed adapter manifest and does not support fake .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json runtime hooks.

happy.desc: .Codex/README template documents the adapter manifest and recommended Codex entrypoint

edge.desc: root README/AGENTS distinguish Codex adapter from Claude hooks/settings/skills

adversarial.desc: docs do not imply .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json will be executed by Codex

verificationEvidence.note: CODEX_README_TEMPLATE documents node bin/koala-codex.js as preferred and the read-only global fallback as fallback only on current HEAD.
Root README and AGENTS are checked for .Codex/koala.json guidance and Codex adapter boundary on current HEAD.
Docs explicitly say .Codex/hooks and .Codex/settings.json are not created/executed by Codex runtime on current HEAD.
